text:
sam: Quick ping — I opened PR #4128 to tighten the batching window and add a graceful fallback when KV cache miss rate spikes. Looking for 1-2 quick reviews so I can merge before tomorrow's staging run. https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4128

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ (unit, integration, perf smoke)

anya: PTAL — do we have perf numbers for the smaller window vs current baseline? curious about p50/p95 token latency impact.

sam: Short answer: p50 ~ unchanged, p95 +6ms on dev bench with synthetic short requests; cost reduced for medium-length traffic due to smaller batches. I can paste numbers in a second.

jun: Can you drop the perf table here and the exact bench command? want to sanity-check on my machine.

sam: Bench snippet: ```bash
# run perf bench
./bench --model llama-13b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --batch-window 8ms --kv-prefetch=true
./bench --model llama-13b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --batch-window 20ms --kv-prefetch=true
```
p50: 42ms -> 44ms
p95: 120ms -> 126ms
cost tokens/sec: +8% improvement for medium seqs (approx)

akash: Nice. Two quick asks before I approve: (1) add a short comment where you change the fallback policy (so FRs understand intent), (2) ensure the fallback metric is tagged so Optimize can pick it up.

sam: Will add both. The fallback metric is currently emitted as `runtime.kv.fallback_count` — I'll add the tag `routing=fallback-window` and a unit test for emission.

maria: skimmed code — looks straightforward. The only race I noticed is when cache miss count flips right at the window boundary; could lead to double scheduling of prewarm. Maybe debounce by 2ms?

sam: Good catch. I added a 2ms debounce in the latest commit (see diff). That should prevent double prewarm.

leo: Minor nit: can you add a changelog line under `serving/runtime`? ops likes to see fallback behavior changes called out.

sam: Added changelog and a short note in the release checklist.

anya: Thanks. I can approve once the comment + metric tag are in.

ci-bot: PR #4128 updated — new commit pushed by sam. CI queued.

jun: Running the bench now on my machine, will post results in ~10m.

sam: Thanks all — appreciate quick eyes. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and kick off a small canary in staging. :thumbsup:

jun: Quick follow-up — my local bench matches your numbers within noise. nothing alarming. approving now.

anya: Approved.

akash: Approved after verifying metric tagging in the new commit.

maria: lgtm

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅

sam: Merged. Will watch staging dashboards for the next hour and post any anomalies.

leo: Thanks! Keep an eye on `latency.edge.p95` and `runtime.kv.fallback_count` in Console.

sam: Will do.
